title: Sobre mí
text:
Soy Anabella Molina, politóloga, doctora en Ciencias Sociales (Universidad de Buenos Aires) y magíster en Ciencia Política (Universidad Torcuato Di Tella). Mi trabajo se mueve en la intersección entre género, instituciones políticas y evidencia empírica, con un foco en América Latina.
Además de mi trabajo académico, participo en proyectos de investigación aplicada y coordinación institucional, articulando alianzas entre organizaciones, gobiernos locales y espacios universitarios. En el plano metodológico, trabajo con diseño de encuestas, métodos comparados, QCA y R.
Podés ver mis publicaciones, docencia, charlas y mi CV en las secciones del sitio.

title: About me
text:
I’m Anabella Molina, a political scientist, PhD in Social Sciences (University of Buenos Aires) and MA in Political Science (Universidad Torcuato Di Tella). My work sits at the intersection of gender, political institutions, and empirical evidence, with a focus on Latin America.
Beyond my academic work, I take part in applied research projects and institutional coordination, building partnerships among organizations, local governments, and universities. Methodologically, I work with survey design, comparative methods, QCA, and R.
You can find my publications, teaching, talks, and CV in the sections of this website.
Download my CV (PDF).

title: Research
text:
Research experience

Doctoral Fellow — UBACyT and CONICET
Gioja Institute, Faculty of Law, University of Buenos Aires (UBA) | 2018–2024
Conducted doctoral research, producing academic work on political institutions, representation, and gender.
Co-Director — Project “Women’s Political Careers in Subnational Contexts”
Universidad Torcuato Di Tella (UTDT) | 2021–2022
Co-led a project aimed at understanding women’s trajectories and the conditions of access to power at the subnational level.
Researcher — PIDAE Project “Legislation on Political Parties in Argentina”
Faculty of Law, University of Buenos Aires (UBA) | 2019–2022
Research on party regulation: legal mapping, systematization, and analysis of reform debates.
Associate Researcher — UBACyT Project “Political Coalitions in Latin America”
University of Buenos Aires (UBA) | 2016–2018
Participated in comparative research on political coalitions in the region.

title: Talks
text:
In this section I compile talks, conferences, panels, and presentations I have taken part in (and will take part in). The idea is simple: so you can see what I’m working on, where we discussed it, and (when available) access materials such as slides, posters, papers, or recordings.

Upcoming: confirmed events (if virtual, I include the time zone).
Archive: past activities, with links to materials when available.






In this talk I presented a summary of my PhD dissertation: Personalism or institutionalization? Two pathways toward gender-parity presidential cabinets** in Latin America (1999–2019)*, for the UBA’s GICP on Gender and Public Policies.
